reviews.author: Luis
reviews.text: Highly recommend Island detailing! They detailed my mother-in-laws car and did an amazing job inside and out.

reviews.author: steve adams
reviews.text: The guys did a great job on my Ford Explorer as it was pretty messed up transporting dogs, and moving, and many trips to the landfill...inside looks new

reviews.author: Jean Kelley
reviews.text: I had my husband’s truck detailed yesterday. The exterior looked brand new when I picked it up. They did a lot of work removing dog hair from the interior in addition to doing a great job on the interior upholstery. Overall I was pleased.

reviews.author: Mary Shannon
reviews.text: Evelio and his team did an amazing job on my mom's car. Dad gave her the gift of a clean car and WOW we're all pleased. The team was fast and efficient, and got us in on short notice. They did a fantastic job at a great price. They're easy to miss driving by, so keep an eye out. They're worth it.

reviews.author: Brian Philemon
reviews.text: I had to really think about what to say in this. I had this company detail and debadge my truck. The truck looked good , but they chipped, scratched, dented and burnt my paint. The owner and the nerve, and lied straight to my face, or his guys lied to him saying it was done from the factory. Honestly I just couldn’t believe what he’s telling me. I’m not stupid and neither is the body repair shops that gave me a price tag over $3000.00 dollars in damages. I guess owning up to your guys mistakes would have been to much.

reviews.author: Sean Bytnar
reviews.text: Exterior and visible interior looked as good as when I first bought my car. I was charged a bit extra because my car was very dirty. Small area under my rear storage compartment was missed. Overall, I am very happy with the end result

reviews.author: Carl Fulmer
reviews.text: I'm from Charlotte but decided to have my 2006 Buick Lacrosse detailed while I was down here with friends. They did a great job. I bought this car for only $1200 and it was in great shape but it was covers with little scratches with little spills on the interior. At a reasonable price, they made the car looks years newer. I am very impressed.

reviews.author: Olivia Butler
reviews.text: You will not be disappointed! Every time I take my car I am blown away. Our driveway is covered with pine trees so my car is always covered in sap and they make it look brand new inside and out every time. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Walter Norton
reviews.text: Wonderful work! The owner Evelio is great to deal with and when he said that he would make my wife's Jeep Wrangler look like new he meant it! He restored the plastic to new, his crew washed and waxed the exterior and vacuumed and cleaned the interior. Pictures to come soon.

reviews.author: kevin
reviews.text: These guys do an amazing job and at a reasonable price. I just picked my boat up and am blown away at how meticulous they are. My boat looks brand new!!

reviews.author: Beth W.
reviews.text: I just picked up my sons Jeep after having it detailed and all I can say is WOW!!! The vehicle looks brand new. A luster and shine I have not seen on that Jeep in years. I can tell the owner takes great pride in his work as he is very meticulous. He does not overlook anything. I love how he and makes sure you are happy with the results upon pickup. If you are looking for an affordable quality service that guarantees happy results Island detailing will not disappoint.

reviews.author: John Mohr
reviews.text: My first time using Island Detailing. Outstanding job inside and out!! My vehicle never looked better. Owner and crew are great and very courteous. My car was cleaned, waxed and polished. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Blain Lefort
reviews.text: Evilio and his team did a fantastic job detailing and drastically improving the look of even an older car. Great communications, attention to detail, and excellent services provided at a fair price. Very happy we had Island Detailing detail and clear headlights!

reviews.author: Jack Roush
reviews.text: You won’t find better detailing anywhere. Great people and top quality work at a reasonable price. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Barbara Morel
reviews.text: Island Detailing made our 7 year old Toyota look like new! It was gleaming…right down to the tires! I couldn’t find a speck of sand or dirt, and he got all the stains out of the floor mats! This guy is a perfectionist and really takes pride in his work!

reviews.author: Randy Gregory
reviews.text: This is a high-quality auto-detailer. Make an appointment, he has plenty of work due to his great work and level of detail. Worth every penny, high quality work. 5 stars!

reviews.author: Nancy Cameron
reviews.text: My car got paint on it from trash spilled on the highway and Island Detailing was able to get it all off. Highly recommend them.

reviews.author: David Petrie
reviews.text: This was the BEST detailing experience I have ever had. Could not recommend more. Will definitely be back!!

reviews.author: William Bogan
reviews.text: Great job, give me a ride to motel, delivered my car and I took him back. I was on vacation but my car needed a goood bath and detailed.

reviews.author: QG Creations LLC
reviews.text: These guys customer service are awesome! Very informative! Very uplifting! I hope to see you succeed further!

reviews.author: Thomas Clark
reviews.text: Fit us in for an emergency interior stain clean-up on short notice. Great work done by great people.

reviews.author: Sue Largo
reviews.text: This establishment is top notch. Very accommodating. The owner went above and beyond. I highly recommend.
